Periodic alarm-category status report. This report identifies a category rather than the exact fault; detailed alarm text is carried separately in PGN 130856. Status 0xFE indicates an active, unacknowledged alarm; 0xFD covers other reportable alarm states whose individual meanings remain unresolved. Manufacturer 1857, marine industry 4, report marker 0xFC.

Fields.Name: Alarm Category
Fields.Description: 4: Off Course. 5: aggregated Autopilot alarms. The meaning of category 66 remains unresolved. This category is not the individual fault ID.

Fields.Name: Alarm Control
Fields.Description: AC42 emits 0xFC for a reportable alarm. The individual bits are not assigned names. This format marker is matched to exclude the all-FF/no-selected-alarm form.

Fields.Name: Alarm Status
Fields.Description: 0xFE: active, unacknowledged alarm. 0xFD: other reportable alarm state; acknowledgement and clearing cannot be distinguished from this value alone.

Fields.Name: Alarm Source Address
Fields.Description: NMEA 2000 source address of the transmitting alarm device, independent of alarm category.

PGNs.Explanation: Vessel configuration broadcast. Byte 2 contains engine count in its low nibble and fuel-tank count in its high nibble. Bytes 3-4 carry total vessel fuel capacity at 0.1 litre per bit. PGN 65303 is the separate set-configuration command; PGN 65304 broadcasts the configuration and supports mismatch detection between devices. Manufacturer 140, marine industry 4. No unavailable sentinel is established for these configuration values.

Fields.Name: Total Vessel Fuel Capacity
Fields.Description: Total vessel fuel capacity at 0.1 litre per bit, carried as an unsigned little-endian 16-bit value.

PGNs.Explanation: Operation 1 advertises a data group's format version, revision, synchronization metadata, serialized length and checksum. Manufacturer 275, marine industry 4; operation occupies the low six bits of byte 3.

Fields.Name: Target Address
Fields.Description: Protocol target address. Value 255 broadcasts to all nodes; other values address a specific node.

Fields.Name: Data Format Version
Fields.Description: One-byte data/schema format version for the advertised group.

Fields.Name: Revision
Fields.Description: Group revision. High values such as 0xFC00 are valid protocol states. Value 0xFC00 indicates that the local persisted revision could not be loaded.

Fields.Name: Synchronization Mode
Fields.Description: Low nibble of the advertised synchronization/registration mode; exact enum meanings are not yet confirmed.

Fields.Name: Flag Bit 4
Fields.Description: Additional group metadata flag. Kept raw rather than guessing its semantics.

Fields.Name: Data Length
Fields.Description: Advertised serialized group-data length. This is not the 15-byte CAN message length.

Fields.Name: Data Checksum
Fields.Description: Checksum of serialized group contents. Start at 0x5CA3; for each byte, XOR it into the accumulator, then rotate the 16-bit accumulator left by one bit.

PGNs.Explanation: Fluid-level and alarm report for manufacturer 140, marine industry 4, product code 1781. Byte 4 contains instance in its low nibble and fluid type in its high nibble; byte 5 contains low/high alarm states. Bytes 6-7 carry alarm thresholds; bytes 8-9 carry level. Alarm state 0 disables, 1 enables without an active indication, and 2 enables with an active indication; states 3 and 4 remain unnamed. Thresholds use percentage values from 0 to 100; other codes have unknown meanings.

Fields.Name: Low Alarm Threshold
Fields.Description: Low alarm threshold byte. Normal configuration values are 0-100 percent. Other codes have unknown meanings.

Fields.Name: High Alarm Threshold
Fields.Description: Threshold byte, retained raw for the same reason as the low threshold. Do not invent an unavailable/disabled sentinel for 124.

Fields.Name: Fluid Level
Fields.Description: Fluid level at 0.004 percent per bit. Raw codes above 0x7FFC are unavailable.

PGNs.Explanation: Low nibble 1 of byte 6 identifies an accumulated log timer, carried as an unsigned 32-bit value at 0.01 seconds per bit. Trip/total distinction and exact reset semantics remain unresolved.

Fields.Name: Log Time

Fields.Name: Circuit ID
Fields.Description: Circuit/channel id for a monitoring report. In ZCF config transfers it instead carries the configuration id (write announce and module advertisement) or the ZCF file size in bytes (download announce).

Fields.Description: Monitoring value. During ZCF transfers it forms part of the configuration descriptor used for conflict detection.

Fields.Description: Transfer control bits. bit0 (0x1) = sync/reset (clears the transfer sequence state); bit1 (0x2) = config-transfer advertise: a read request when the id field is 0, otherwise a write announce (tool) or download announce (module).

Fields.Name: DIP Switch
Fields.Description: CZone module DIP-switch address of the sender or target. 0xFF = broadcast / all modules.

Fields.Name: Target
Fields.Description: Echoes the DataBlock write target. Value 0xFF indicates broadcast; otherwise the target is a module DIP-switch address. Only an ACK matching the current write target is accepted.

Fields.Name: Status
Fields.Description: 0 = data block stored OK; 1 = terminator accepted / transfer complete.

Fields.Name: Configuration Block Index
Fields.Description: The PGN 130816 block index being acknowledged.

Fields.Name: Module DIP Switch
Fields.Description: DIP-switch address of the acknowledging module. Must match the address advertised by the module when registering for the transfer.

PGNs.Description: BEP Marine: CZone Circuit Extended State
PGNs.Explanation: CZone circuit extended state message. The message identifies the module by DIP switch, module type, and channel page, followed by 32 LSB-first circuit flags. The module type selects whether the flags describe 32, 16, or 8 channels per page and whether additional status banks are present.

Fields.Name: DIP Switch
Fields.Description: CZone module DIP-switch / module instance byte

Fields.Name: Page
Fields.Description: Field/page value, used as high page bits for the channel number

Fields.Name: Circuit Flags
Fields.Description: 32 LSB-first flags. Module types 8, 9, and 14 use a 32-channel/page direct state layout; module types 11, 16, and 17 use a 16-channel/page direct state layout; module types 28 and 31 use an 8-channel/page extended status layout; other module types use an 8-channel/page default layout.

Fields.Name: Configuration Block Index
Fields.Description: Sequential transfer block number. The corresponding ZCF file offset is usually the block number multiplied by 200 bytes.

Fields.Name: Target
Fields.Description: Write target / broadcast selector. The receiving module echoes this byte in the DataBlock ACK (PGN 65291) target field. 0xFF = broadcast (network write to all modules); otherwise the target module DIP-switch address.

Fields.Name: Padding
Fields.Description: 18 bytes of 0xFF padding between the 5-byte header and the file data (bytes 5..22 of the reassembled payload).

Fields.Name: ZCF File Data
Fields.Description: ZCF file fragment, up to 200 bytes, written at the block number multiplied by 200 bytes. A zero-length fragment marks the transfer terminator. Block 0 starts with a 6-byte ZCF header: 0x06, a 32-bit little-endian length, then a header CRC-8. The configuration payload follows; the file's final byte is the payload CRC-8 (polynomial 0x07).
